请检查当前脚本的叙事和节奏，先给出修改建议。: Review the current script’s narrative and pacing, and suggest improvements first.
请查看当前分镜，补充每个镜头的机位、运动与动作节拍。: Review the storyboard and flesh out each shot’s camera position, movement and action beats.
请检查分镜构图、画格状态与图片参考，指出需要补充的内容。: Check the composition, frame status and image references, and identify what is missing.

帮我写一支 30 秒短片的完整声画脚本，保存到脚本工作区。: Write the complete audiovisual script for a 30-second short and save it in the script workspace.
请先查看项目中的素材，基于已有内容提出可以实现的短片方案。: Review the project’s media first, then suggest a feasible short film using what is available.
想怎么调整？: What would you like to change?
选中的素材已带入。直接说想怎么改，Agent 会在对话里制作，结果同时放回画布。: The selected media is attached. Describe your changes; the Agent will create results in the conversation and add them to the canvas.
输入 @ 选择脚本、镜头或素材，告诉我想改什么。: Use @ to select a script, shot or media item, then describe what you want to change.
用 $ 选择创意、分镜、制作、剪辑或审片 Agent。不指定时由项目统筹梳理目标: Use $ to choose a writing, storyboard, production, editing or review Agent. Otherwise, the producer will help define the goal.

保存目标、约束与关键决定。同一项目的 Agent 共享，切换模型或清空聊天后保留: Save goals, constraints and key decisions. Shared by this project’s Agents and retained when you switch models or clear the chat.
允许 Agent 读取已有记忆。关闭后保留内容，暂停读取和自动整理。: Allow Agents to read existing memory. Turning this off keeps the contents but pauses reading and automatic organization.
允许有记忆写入权限的 Agent 保存新增或变化的长期偏好与约束， 保留原话来源: Agents with memory permissions may save lasting preferences and constraints with their original sources, without duplicating scripts, shots or timeline content.
